description: List the household's employees and return the household's employer_id. Call this first: it is how you get the employee_id every payroll tool needs. Each employee shows pay type, pay rate, pay frequency, work state, and what is still missing for payroll (W-4, address, SSN, direct deposit). Read-only.

employer_id.description: Optional. Leave it out to use the household your API key belongs to. Pass it only when one account manages several households; list_employees returns it.

name: list_employees
